prose: Basis: the Wall Street Journal blocks automated fetching (HTTP 403), so this note rests on Techmeme's account. Anthropic is aiming to go public the week of November 16 and could raise around $100 billion at a valuation of $1.5 to $2 trillion, according to the Journal's sources. The company had initially prepared for an October debut. Its filing did not disclose the targeted valuation or the number of shares it plans to sell.
highlights: Anthropic targets going public the week of November 16, per WSJ sources
A raise of ~$100B at a $1.5T-$2T valuation is on the table
The debut was initially prepared for October before slipping
The S-1 itself discloses neither valuation target nor share count
